reason: I already have more work than I can handle and I'm planning to wind the business down in a few years, so catching more callers is the last thing I need. I'm not signing up for another monthly thing now.
objection: More calls means more work I can't take, and I don't want another subscription and setup to deal with from a brand-new company with no customers when I'm on my way out.
would_change_my_mind: If the 'ausgebucht' mode alone could keep everyone except emergencies and my regulars away from me, with zero setup on my side and no forwarding fiddling, I might try the free month.
